events.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Real Madrid 1, Inter Milan 0. Kylian Mbappé (Real Madrid) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Brahim Díaz.
Goal! Real Madrid 2, Inter Milan 0. Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Delay in match because of an injury Thibaut Courtois (Real Madrid).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Hakan Çalhanoglu (Inter Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Inter Milan. John Stones replaces Benjamin Pavard.
Second Half begins Real Madrid 2, Inter Milan 0.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Petar Sucic replaces Nicolò Barella.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Piotr Zielinski replaces Hakan Çalhanoglu.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Ange-Yoan Bonny replaces Marcus Thuram.
Delay in match because of an injury Yann Bisseck (Inter Milan).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Real Madrid 2, Inter Milan 1. Carlos Augusto (Inter Milan) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Lautaro Martínez.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Aurélien Tchouaméni replaces Trent Alexander-Arnold.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Yan Diomande replaces Brahim Díaz.
Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) is shown the yellow card.
Lautaro Martínez (Inter Milan) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Henrikh Mkhitaryan replaces Carlos Augusto.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Álvaro Carreras replaces Vinícius Júnior.

Yann Bisseck (Inter Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
